mintAuthority.summary: EUSD is a Reserve Protocol RToken with permissionless basket-funded issuance. Its Main OWNER path includes a TimelockController with a three-day minimum delay. The separate Reserve RoleRegistry Safe does not hold Main's OWNER role and cannot be treated as an immediate eUSD upgrade administrator. Mint-critical upgrade and basket authority remain economically unbounded pending complete process and execution-scope proof.

controls.label: eUSD RToken (permissionless basket mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint is 1:1 against the current collateral basket only; supply is bounded by deposited collateral, with arbitrage holding the peg.

review.evidence: Source-scoped correction researched 2026-10-20; original whole-review start retained. The earlier review joined eUSD to the wrong authority: RoleRegistry 0xe1ec57c8ee970280f237863910b606059e9641c9 administers Reserve version/plugin registries, not the eUSD Main OWNER role. At Ethereum block 26236709 (hash 0x93923d0d20b3b1fd1d751aa514e0b09fdda9548b97689c81fe8e8d8feb172bb2; 2026-10-20T22:12:59Z), the exact eUSD RToken points to Main 0x7697ae4def3c3cd52493ba3a6f57fc6d8c59108a, Main points to verified MainP1 0xc5bf686cfb85786fcfff557297d4aff8f4e15e44, and the RToken implementation remains 0x258ce833cf9ad19208372763a00aa1565dd40b3c. Main.hasRole(bytes32(bytes('OWNER')),Timelock 0xd979cf15f7275a3df838513ab911587d23b6d29e)=true; the same OWNER check for Safe 0xe8259842e71f4e44f2f68d6bfbc15eda56e63064=false. Timelock.getMinDelay()=259200 seconds. Main source requires OWNER for upgradeMainTo/upgradeRTokenTo and OWNER administers its own roles; the registry Safe cannot be described as directly granting itself Main OWNER. Basket-funded public issue() remains distinct from privileged basket and mint-critical upgrade reach. Economic cap semantics and unbounded-adverse posture are retained conservatively: no complete D29/D30/H process certificate, D32 voting census, alternate-authority closure or independently admitted recurring whole-liability reconciliation is supplied. Owner review required; no process uplift follows from correcting the authority identity. FIX-ROUND1 correction 2026-10-20: supervision none had no recorded positive-absence basis. Protocol-native RToken mechanics and an unidentified issuing supervisor do not establish absence of supervision. Normalize to unknown without changing reconciliation, authority facts or the original July 20 review start.
